enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, drinking coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Open cupboard and take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open jar of coffee and add coffee to mug. Pour hot water and stir. Take eggs off stove. Put eggs on plate. Take toast from toaster. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Put in stethoscope, badge, pens, notebook. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating charts
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on lab coat. Go to nurses station. Pick up patient list. Review charts. Use hand sanitizer. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Ask questions. Update chart on computer. Use hand sanitizer. Walk to next patient. Visit next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, patient care and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Return to nurses station. Check patient list. Use hand sanitizer. Visit patients. Administer medication. Change dressings. Record vitals. Update charts. Communicate with doctors. Prepare handover notes. Attend handover meeting. Report to next shift.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Place dishes in sink. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in dish rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop on a show. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like posts. Comment. Open video app. Watch video. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and doing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Apply moisturizer.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking the phone under the desk lamp to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Reply. Open reading app. Read article. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp.
Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.
